## Purpose

<!-- hand:purpose -->
> Draft — owner review pending.

How the simulation is shown and heard: the renderer (sweep lanes, numeric tiles, the alarm header, the 12-lead view),
audio (QRS and pulse tones, alarm sounds, device tones), skins (each monitor's look and behaviour as data) and the demo
app with its physiology console. There is no physiology here: it draws and sounds what the engine and the device layer
publish. A clinician-educator can see why the screen and sound behave like a monitor; an embedding developer gets the
renderer, audio and skin contracts.
<!-- /hand:purpose -->

## Equations in words

<!-- hand:equations -->
> Draft — owner review pending.

- Sweep position comes from sim time, never from frame counts: x = (simT · mm/s · px/mm) mod lane width, with a default
  of 96 CSS px per inch (3.78 px/mm) until the user calibrates (`packages/renderer/src/calibration.ts`; research/05
  §3.1).
- Each device-pixel column keeps its first, last, minimum and maximum sample, so QRS and VF crests are never averaged
  away (`packages/renderer/src/decimate.ts`).
- A pressure lane maps its scale range [lo, hi] to baseline = hi/(hi − lo) and gain = height/((hi − lo)·px/mm); the
  pleth is auto-scaled (`packages/renderer/src/wave-lanes.ts`).
- Display units: displayed value = engine value × scale, e.g. mmHg·s/mL to dyn·s/cm⁵
  (`apps/demo/src/physiology-console/meta.ts`, `apps/demo/src/app/vitals.ts`).
- Clock mapping: wallMs(t) = anchorWall + (t − anchorSim)·1000/timeScale and audioTime = contextTime + (wallMs −
  performanceTime)/1000 (`packages/audio/src/clock-map.ts`; web.dev "A tale of two clocks").
- A 25 ms timer schedules every tone due in the next 100 ms; a late tone plays at once, and a QRS tone is dropped only
  if it would sound more than 150 ms after its R wave (`packages/audio/src/scheduler.ts`).
- The QRS/pulse beep is 60 ms, sine plus second harmonic, at a fixed 880 Hz or pitched by SpO2 as
  baseHz·2^(−(100 − SpO2)·s/12) with s 0.1 ('nellcor-like') or 0.4 ('enhanced') semitone per %
  (`packages/audio/src/tones.ts`, `packages/audio/src/profiles/pitch-maps.ts`; research 03 §3.6, 05 §2.5).
- The engine's `alarmStatus` event is the single source of alarm sound: only the highest priority sounds (ties: first
  raised), and acknowledged alarms are silent (`packages/renderer/src/alarm-audio.ts`).
- A skin resolves as base ← skin ← preset ← theme; objects merge key by key, arrays and scalars replace
  (`packages/skins/src/resolve.ts`, `packages/skins/src/merge.ts`).
<!-- /hand:equations -->

## State

### `ViewState` ([`apps/demo/src/app/mechanisms/graph.ts`](../../apps/demo/src/app/mechanisms/graph.ts))

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `depth` | `number` | Generations drawn past the trigger (default DEPTH). |
| `maxChildren` | `number` | Children a node shows before "n more" (default MAX_CHILDREN). |
| `expanded` | `ReadonlySet<string>` | Frontier nodes opened by "show more" (one generation each). |
| `opened` | `ReadonlySet<string>` | Folds opened: a device box's id (`device.<module>`) or a node's "n more" (`more.<node id>`). |
| `pathTo` | `string` | Keep only the routes from the trigger to this node id (the depth cut and the folds do not apply). |
| `slack` | `number` | How many generations longer than the shortest a route to `pathTo` may be (default PATH_SLACK). |
| `whole` | `boolean` | The whole tree, nothing folded. |

### [`apps/demo/src/app/meters.ts`](../../apps/demo/src/app/meters.ts)

| Name | Value | Unit | Source / tag | Comment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CPU_WINDOW_MS` | `2000` | ms | — | Home's three live tiles (E125): Engine (ms per tick), Memory (MB used) and "CPU, this app" (% of one core). They run only while Home is on screen. What each one measures, exactly: - Engine: the median time of one 20-ms engine tick, measured by engine-bench.worker.ts on the same engine build in a background thread of this page (the monitor's own worker has no timing hook). Updated every 5 s. - Memory: `performance.memory.usedJSHeapSize` of this page (Chromium only); a browser without it (Safari, Firefox) has no Memory tile (MUI-17). The workers' heaps (the monitor's engine among them) are not in it. - CPU, this app: the MAIN THREAD's busy fraction over the last 2 s, in % of one core. Busy time = the long tasks a `PerformanceObserver` reports (`longtask`, every task of 50 ms or more, exact) + the frame overruns seen by requestAnimationFrame (an interval longer than 1.5 frames counts its excess over one frame as busy) that no long task already covers. Short tasks that delay no frame are not seen, and the monitor's engine and drawing run in their own worker thread, so this is the instructor page's own load, not the whole browser's. MUI-17: the owner's 2 s (it was 5 s: a change of load took 5 s to show). 2 s holds 120 frames at 60 Hz, so one frame's overrun (16.7 ms) moves the tile by 0.8 % — finer than the whole-percent it prints. |

### [`co2-range.ts`](../../packages/renderer/src/co2-range.ts)

| Name | Value | Unit | Source / tag | Comment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CO2_WIDEN_BREATHS` | `2` | — | Nov 2026; research/06 §3.2; [ENG: display] | The capnogram lane's auto-range (skin `co2.autoScales`; owner ruling of 1 Nov 2026, E63 revisited): the lane widens its scale when the plateau exceeds it and narrows back when it falls, with hysteresis, as real units do. Vendor behaviour: the Saadat B9 offers a CO2 scale AUTO beside its fixed ones (research/06 §3.2, M p.304–305); capnographs in auto-scale pick the scale from the measured EtCO2, i.e. from breath peaks, and offer steps such as 0–60/0–80/0–100 mmHg. None states a breath count or a margin, so these are [ENG: display]: - the judged value is each breath's peak as the engine's EtCO2 detector finds it (engine-core co2-numerics.ts: a breath rises above 50 % of a decaying recent peak and ends below 30 %), read from the same displayed samples, never a single sample; - WIDEN one step after CO2_WIDEN_BREATHS consecutive breaths whose peak EXCEEDS the current top (over 50 on the 50 lane, over 80 on the 80 lane: the plateau would be clipped), so a plateau of 49.5 stays on the 0–50 scale (orchestrator's ruling on #250, 2 Nov: the MH card's early-signs stop stays on 0–50, as in every rehearsal); - NARROW one step after CO2_NARROW_BREATHS consecutive breaths whose peak stays under CO2_NARROW_UNDER of the next-lower top (40 of 50, 64 of 80). The band between (40–50 on the 50/80 step) is the hysteresis: a lane at 80 with peaks of 45 stays at 80, a lane at 50 with peaks of 45 stays at 50, so it never flaps at 50; - nothing above the widest top widens further: the trace clips at the lane top there (E63 at the top range); - no breath (apnoea, a detached line) changes nothing. The judgement runs over the engine's samples in index order, never over frames, so every window drawing the same timeline (the instructor's screen, a learner monitor, a phone: sample-identical engines) takes the same steps at the same breaths, as the pleth auto-scale and the ECG auto-gain are computed in each window from the same samples. Consecutive breaths at the roof before the lane widens (two, as the EtCO2 number needs two breaths and the ECG auto-gain two windows: one spike never widens) [ENG: display]. |
| `CO2_NARROW_BREATHS` | `6` | — | [ENG: display] | Consecutive breaths well under the lower scale before the lane narrows (three times as long: ≈ 30 s at RR 12) [ENG: display]. |
| `CO2_NARROW_UNDER` | `0.8` | — | [ENG: display] | A breath peak under this fraction of the next-lower top counts towards narrowing [ENG: display]. |

### [`ecg-gain.ts`](../../packages/renderer/src/ecg-gain.ts)

| Name | Value | Unit | Source / tag | Comment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AUTO_GAIN_WINDOW_S` | `4` | s | [ENG: display] | The ECG auto-gain's judgement (Saadat-like `ecg.gainDefault: "AUTO"`): which of the skin's discrete sizes a lane shows. Vendor behaviour: Philips IntelliVue "Auto Size" lets the monitor choose the adjustment factor from the size set for each displayed ECG wave (MP20–MP90 IFU M8000-9001K §"Changing the Size of the ECG Wave"; MX400–MX800 IFU 453564443141); Mindray "Auto" adjusts the wave size (BeneView T5/T8/T9 manual 6800-20-50657 §9.5.11). Neither states a cadence, a hysteresis or a beat rule, so these are [ENG: display]: the size is judged per 4-s window on the beats' median amplitude, and a new size is taken only when it has been asked for by two consecutive windows and the amplitude has left a band around the current size's threshold (US 6,510,339 B2 likewise waits for agreement among several measurements). Every judgement looks at one window of this length, on the sim clock's grid (windows [kW − W, kW]) [ENG: display]. |
| `AUTO_GAIN_FILL` | `0.6` | — | [ENG: display] | The window's amplitude should fill at most this share of the lane's nominal height (RR-2) [ENG: display]. |
| `AUTO_GAIN_HOLD` | `2` | — | [ENG: display; brief rule, no manual states one] | Consecutive windows that must ask for the same new size before it is shown [ENG: display; brief rule, no manual states one]. |
| `AUTO_GAIN_BAND` | `0.2` | — | [ENG: display] | Hysteresis: a smaller size needs the amplitude this fraction over the current size's threshold, a larger one this fraction under its own threshold. The sizes step ×2, so the bands never overlap [ENG: display]. |
| `NOMINAL_ECG_LANE_MM` | `30` | — | [ENG: display] | The nominal ECG lane (mm) of a skin with no measured screen (layout.grid with sweep.pxPerMm) [ENG: display]. |

### [`worker-host.ts`](../../packages/renderer/src/worker-host.ts)

| Name | Value | Unit | Source / tag | Comment |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `READY_LATE_MS` | `2000` | ms | [ENG: control] | N48 (brief 126): a worker not ready this long after its start is LATE, and the page says so (`pme-monitor-worker-late`; `pme-monitor-worker-ready` when it is). The monitor keeps waiting for it: a late worker is still loading, not lost. Until brief 126 the page fell back to the main thread here for good, in silence, so a busy start decided the render path by a clock (on the dev server under background QoS, 2 workers: 4 of 5 page loads; the one that made it was ready at 1745 ms), and that path froze the page through a fast-forward (N47). Waited for, the same five loads were ready at 2.2–6.0 s. A built page's worker is one inline bundle and is ready well inside it; the Vite dev server loads it one module per request (278–1875 ms on an idle Mac). A worker that fails (an error before 'ready') still hands the monitor to the main thread, and the page says that too (`pme-monitor-main-thread`). 2 s: above every idle start measured, so a normal start says nothing [ENG: control]. |
| `WORKER_SILENT_MS` | `3000` | ms | [ENG: display] | A worker silent this long with requests waiting is SLOW (warned: `pme-monitor-slow`). It posts every ≤ 250 ms — its frames, and from inside a long run its progress (MonitorCore.onProgress) — measured on a Mac (gaps between its messages, FX-11a): p99.9 270 ms idle, 267 ms with 16 CPU-bound processes, 436 ms with those and the browser at background QoS (Chromium; WebKit ≤ 269 ms): 3 s is 7× the longest gap measured. It is DEAD when, past this, a probe worker started at the warning has answered — the machine runs workers and this one makes no progress; a starved machine starves the probe too, and the monitor waits (FX-11a) [ENG: display]. |

| [`numerics-neuro.ts`](../../packages/renderer/src/numerics-neuro.ts) | The neuro model's NMT (train-of-four) and BFA (BIS-like depth index) tiles. |
| [`numerics-organs.ts`](../../packages/renderer/src/numerics-organs.ts) | Organ numeric tiles: ICP (mean) with CPP, PbtO2, urine output (mL/h over 60 min, cumulative). |
| [`numerics-resp.ts`](../../packages/renderer/src/numerics-resp.ts) | Respiratory numeric tiles (brief §6.1, §6.8): SpO2 with PI, EtCO2 with FiCO2 and awRR, RR (impedance) and temperature T1/T2. |
| [`overlays.ts`](../../packages/renderer/src/overlays.ts) | Event overlays on the ECG lanes (brief §3.5 step 5; research/05 §2.6): pace marks, sync markers, shock marks and lead-off dashes. |
| [`protocol.ts`](../../packages/renderer/src/protocol.ts) | Messages between the main thread and the engine+renderer worker (brief §3.4). |
| [`skin-plan.ts`](../../packages/renderer/src/skin-plan.ts) | ResolvedSkin → RenderPlan: the plain-data lane layout the worker draws from. |
| [`sweep-lane.ts`](../../packages/renderer/src/sweep-lane.ts) | One sweep lane (brief §3.5 "Per frame, for each lane"): x comes from sim time, never from frame counts. |
| [`tile-fit.ts`](../../packages/renderer/src/tile-fit.ts) | Saadat pass 3 (the owner's 2026-10-23 review): how the parts of a split tile fit their width. |
| [`views.ts`](../../packages/renderer/src/views.ts) | Device-layer views drawn on a plain canvas: the 12-lead report (brief §6.6: 3×4 + lead II rhythm strip, 25 mm/s, 10 mm/mV, calibration pulses, on ECG paper) and the graphic trend (brief §6.7; `trend.style` line or filled |
| [`wave-lanes.ts`](../../packages/renderer/src/wave-lanes.ts) | Haemodynamic waveform lanes (brief §3.5, §6.8 colours): ABP red, pleth cyan, CVP blue, PAP yellow, drawn by the existing SweepLane at 125 Hz. |
| [`worker-host.ts`](../../packages/renderer/src/worker-host.ts) | Main-thread side of the engine+renderer (brief §3.4): an OffscreenCanvas worker when possible, the same MonitorCore on the main thread otherwise. |
| [`calendar.ts`](../../packages/skins/src/calendar.ts) | Header / trend date formatting (brief §3.8 `calendar`; research 06 §5.1 item 13): Gregorian in the skin's format, or Solar Hijri (Jalali) as YYYY/MM/DD with Latin digits through Intl's persian calendar. |
| [`color.ts`](../../packages/skins/src/color.ts) | Colour helpers: WCAG 2.x relative luminance and contrast ratio, and the theme transform that darkens a colour (HSL lightness only, hue and saturation kept) until it reaches a contrast ratio on a light background. |
| [`index.ts`](../../packages/skins/src/index.ts) | @pme/skins: skins as data (brief §3.8). |
| [`merge.ts`](../../packages/skins/src/merge.ts) | Deep merge for skin data: plain objects merge key by key, arrays and scalars (and null) replace. |
| [`provenance.ts`](../../packages/skins/src/provenance.ts) | Provenance coverage: every leaf value of a skin must be covered by a provenance entry whose key is the leaf's dotted path or a prefix of it (so one entry can cover a whole block that shares a source). |
| [`registry.ts`](../../packages/skins/src/registry.ts) | Every shipped skin, base, theme and preset (brief §3.8; build order saadat-like → philips-like → zoll-like, then mindray-like, ge-like, lifepak-like). |
| [`resolve.ts`](../../packages/skins/src/resolve.ts) | resolveSkin: the renderer/audio-facing contract (packages/skins/CONTRACT.md). |
| [`schema.ts`](../../packages/skins/src/schema.ts) | JSON Schemas (draft-07, validated with ajv) for skins, themes and presets (brief §3.8). |
| [`types.ts`](../../packages/skins/src/types.ts) | Skin data model (brief §3.8; research 06 §5 is the reference instance). |
| [`validate.ts`](../../packages/skins/src/validate.ts) | Runtime validation with ajv (MIT, NOTICES). |

| Target (band) | Measured | Source | Audit verdict | Audit's proposed band | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| airway not secured: the first ineffective 31–41 mL breath comes before the pulse loss | none at all | — | not audited | — | [`healthy-induction.slow.test.ts`](../../apps/demo/src/app/showcase/healthy-induction.slow.test.ts) |
| untreated: VF from hyperthermia | no VF in 51 min | — | not audited | — | [`malignant-hyperthermia.slow.test.ts`](../../apps/demo/src/app/showcase/malignant-hyperthermia.slow.test.ts) |
| treated late (the run-sheet path): crisis 1 min into the established crisis | the call comes at +46.6 min | — | not audited | — | [`malignant-hyperthermia.slow.test.ts`](../../apps/demo/src/app/showcase/malignant-hyperthermia.slow.test.ts) |
| sysMaxAtRosc 194.9–204.9 mmHg, the physiology alone (191.07 + 8.9 from the coronary reading) | 210.8 | — | not audited | — | [`stab-wound-tamponade.slow.test.ts`](../../apps/demo/src/app/showcase/stab-wound-tamponade.slow.test.ts) |
